name: cmfas-exams
description: Static study site (guides, quizzes, mock exams) for the Singapore CMFAS / IBF capital markets exams: RES 12B, FMRP and CM-SIP.

scripts.questions:rebalance: node scripts/rebalance-answers.mjs --exam cmsip --write && node scripts/rebalance-answers.mjs --exam fmrp --write && node scripts/rebalance-answers.mjs --exam res12b --write
scripts.verify: node scripts/audit-guides.mjs --strict && node scripts/audit-banks.mjs --strict && node scripts/check-answer-text.mjs && npm run test:parser && npm run check && npm run build
